role: PostHog analytics integration for SPA pageview tracking with environment-gated initialization
detail: Two main exports: initAnalytics() initializes PostHog SDK only if VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN is set, with capture_pageview disabled and person_profiles set to 'identified_only' to prevent quota burn on anonymous traffic; useAnalyticsPageviews() is a React hook that leverages useLocation() to capture explicit pageviews on every route change, composing the full URL from window.location.origin + pathname + search. Module holds two module-scoped variables: posthog (PostHog instance, null if uninitialized) and posthogReady (Promise that resolves after SDK import and init complete). The SDK disables automatic pageview capture and implements pageleave tracking to avoid double-firing landing-page views.
gotchas: Module-scoped posthog and posthogReady variables persist across hook invocations; no cleanup/teardown logic; relies on environment variables that may be unset; no error handling if PostHog init fails.
